rules.clause: Meals are reimbursed up to USD 50.00 per expense.
Ground transport (taxis, rideshare, trains) is limited to USD 100.00 per employee per week.
Ground transport is reimbursable Monday to Friday only; a weekend ride with a written justification goes to manager review.
Flights are reimbursed up to USD 700.00 per ticket.
Software subscriptions are limited to USD 300.00 per employee per calendar month.
Training courses and conferences are reimbursed up to USD 2,000.00 per expense.
Software or training expenses above USD 500.00 require a pre-approval ID from your manager.
Entertainment is not reimbursable for the Engineering team.

uncompilable.clause: Client meals require a reasonable business justification.
uncompilable.reason: Whether a justification is reasonable needs human judgement, and the engine cannot tell client meals from other meals.

uncompilable.clause: Hotel stays are reimbursed up to USD 180.00 per night.
uncompilable.reason: The cap is per night, but max_amount caps a whole expense and one hotel expense can cover several nights. The engine cannot check it without the number of nights.

uncompilable.clause: We prefer partner hotels whenever one is available.
uncompilable.reason: A preference, not a limit; partner hotels are not part of the expense data.

uncompilable.clause: Book economy class unless the flight is longer than 8 hours.
uncompilable.reason: Fare class and flight duration are not part of the expense data.
Whether an expense is personal cannot be decided from category and amount.
